home.diffBody: Most chat roulettes route your video through their servers and push accounts or ads. On ruletka.vip, video goes browser to browser (peer-to-peer) — no signup. Friends, block, report, and on-device safety tools are built in.
home.finalLead: No account. Camera stays peer-to-peer. Tap in and spin.
home.foot: 18+ · Be respectful · Use Block if needed
home.lead: Random video chat with strangers — or call friends when they’re online. Media stays between browsers. No account required.
home.openBody: This software is open source (LGPL-2.1). Anyone can run their own hub. This site is a public seed — not the only network. If a hub goes down, the live app can try other hubs from a public directory. Helpers run a full chat node you can share.
home.p2d: Video goes peer-to-peer, not uploaded to us
home.p3d: Share a code, accept requests, call when online
home.p4d: Report, block, blur-first, on-device AI skip — multi-report auto-restricts
home.title:
Meet someone new.
Face to face.

seed.advLead: For people who already have a VPS and HTTPS. Federation is by invite only so random nodes can’t take over the site.
seed.c1d: Open live, match someone. Your video is P2P. No install.
seed.c2d: One download for Windows, Mac, or Linux. It runs in the background and helps the match pool. You don’t get site admin access.

seed.lead: When you chat, your camera goes straight to the other person — not to our media servers. That’s already peer-to-peer. You can also run a small helper on your computer so more people can find each other, without controlling this website.
